data.fixed_clause: The applicant acknowledges and agrees that all disclosed sensitive categories, including background details, may be processed under our legitimate operational interest framework to enhance profile-based candidate engagement across all corporate divisions, provided that health status and religious affiliation are strictly excluded from legitimate-interest processing, promotional communications, and marketing.
